as_of_content:
The '''Blaster Relics''' are rewarded for mastering the [[Bring the Noise]] Spotlight Missions.

== Description ==
''An award to celebrate the good times that have been had mastering the [[Blaster]] Special Missions.''

== Relic Boosts ==
* (Tier 1): +2% Health in Raids when attacking.
* Bronze: +3%
* Silver: +4%
* Gold: +5%
